intent: Propose the bounded WP-0G (TIT-008) prerequisite amendment that a human merge would ratify: replace the privileged rolling-repair design with contents-read-only CI that emits deterministic, non-authoritative projections bound to the exact tested commit, tree, tracked inputs, generator, and output bytes; admit .gitattributes to Titanium ownership; and immediately remove merge=union from AUTO_INVENTORY.md and SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md so Git cannot silently concatenate their managed blocks. This governance-only packet implements no projection generator, workflow, or delivery lane and makes no WP-0G completion claim.

gates.name: amendment-governance-contracts
gates.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_active_track_governance.py tests/test_track_closure_rigor.py tests/test_claim_evidence_binding.py tests/test_docops_integrity.py

interface_mismatches: .gitattributes assigns merge=union to docs/docops/AUTO_INVENTORY.md and docs/governance/SOVEREIGN_MANIFEST.md even though both carry machine-managed content; the existing CLAUDE.md exclusion documents that union merge can preserve both generated blocks and create invalid duplicated content.

The ratified WP-0G text requires a privileged rolling repair branch and credential-backed delivery, while the requested future-proof boundary is a write-free exact-SHA projection with no repository repair authority.
INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md contains no open entry for this bounded governance/document-merge seam at exact post-#1210 main f2ffb4390c603dc9f8f2c36fcaaca0c4ba0ce9cd.
honest_blockers: This packet proposes authority only. The exact-SHA projection generator, read-only workflow, artifact verifier, retirement of rolling repair, and adversarial implementation tests remain blocked until a human merges this amendment.

This candidate refreshes PR #1212 itself as the governance-only prerequisite amendment. Its previous derived-status workflow and manual-reconcile implementation are superseded rather than silently co-merged with the separate write-free core.

PR #1118 remains a separate two-file generated-count refresh whose direct parent is the same exact base. This amendment carries only its own generator-derived projection changes; whichever PR lands second must rebase and rerun the generator rather than copy the other's count delta.

Removing merge=union intentionally converts silent duplicate-block auto-merges into explicit conflicts. Reviewers must resolve or regenerate the managed blocks rather than accept concatenated truth claims.

The canonical AgentOps closeout intentionally refuses every .gitattributes mutation because a packet cannot change the policy used to measure its own scope. This amendment preserves that exact nonzero result and uses the specification's amendment-only preflight, raw-tree, focused-check, independent-review, and human-merge boundary; no successful AgentOps scope closeout is claimed.
This packet observes only a local clean checkout and local deterministic checks. It changes no production service, GitHub setting, workflow, credential, or external system.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this governance amendment as one unit: restore the prior WP-0G plan and active-track wording, remove .gitattributes from Titanium ownership, restore the two merge attributes, regenerate active-track and DocOps projections, and remove the packet. Rollback reopens the privileged rolling-repair design problem and must not be described as a safe steady state.
